name: cyberprompt
description: CYBERPROMPT — your prompts jack in raw, they jack out preem. Advisory prompt rewriting for Claude Code, guarded by deterministic gates.

plugins.name: cyberprompt
plugins.description: Automatic prompt optimizer: a UserPromptSubmit hook rewrites every prompt via a headless, tool-less claude -p call using the bundled claude-5 prompting references plus a bounded, quarantined slice of recent session turns (reference resolution only), validates the result with deterministic gates (schema, verbatim source quotes, length ceiling), and injects it as an advisory contract — the original prompt always wins. Includes the cyberprompt management skill and the claude-5 prompting skill.
